[[Writ of Experience]] is a consumable that grants 5% of the [[experience]] needed to reach the next level. After the [[Wizard's Vault]] replaced the old [[daily]] system, they can only be acquired from a limited number of achievements related to [[Seasons of the Dragons]].

== Notes ==
* Cannot be used in [[combat]].
* Cannot be used at [[level]] 80.

== Trivia ==
* As part of [[skill point]]s rework to [[hero point]]s, the [[Game updates/2015-06-23|23 June 2015 game update]] removed the possibility to use at level 80 and introduced the [[Tome of Knowledge]] trade.
